answer: Every new identity must lock its own refundable bond, and the bond doubles for each extra account created in the same window. An honest agent's cost stays near its nadir, but a sybil farmer pays the full doubled price for every clone, with no way to share one bond across accounts, and one caught cheat slashes the whole cluster. Crossing the meadow alone is nearly free; sending raven after raven to fake a crowd becomes ruinously expensive.
